graph.title: Reaction game (micro:bit)
notes: This is a software-only MakeCode project: no external wiring, breadboard or components are used. The only physical part is the micro:bit, which has its on-board buttons A and B and its 5x5 LED display.

The two images show the loop condition 'while not (button A pressed) and not (button B pressed)'. The Arabic UI labels read: أثناء = while, ليس = not, الزر = button, مضغوط = pressed, و = and, تنفيذ = do.

The code logic is: pause 1000 ms plus a random 0-4000 ms, show an image for 1 s, then wait until A or B is pressed (20 ms pause per loop), then show an arrow for the winner. This logic is not part of the physical build graph.
The micro:bit is not in the catalogue, so I added it as a new part type. I gave the buttons the port kind 'lug' as the closest allowed kind.
The USB cable and computer used to download the .hex file are not described in the manual, so I did not add them.
The optional 'Keep score' challenge uses variables only, so it adds no hardware.
